Paragraph: When Lakshmana flew into a rage upon hearing of Rama's exile, threatening to overthrow King Dasaratha by force, Rama embraced him gently and said: 'I know your peerless love and valor, brother. But anger blinds the mind to righteousness. Controlling anger brings true strength. Channel your energy into helping me fulfill our duty with grace.'
Situation/Problem_Faced: Explosive indignation, protective anger, and impulsive urges to use violence against perceived injustice.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama validates Lakshmana's love while de-escalating his rage, encouraging him to channel his passion into constructive duty.
Outcome/Resolution: Lakshmana calms down, redirecting his protective instincts toward accompanying Rama to serve him in the forest.
Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Rama shows that true strength lies in controlling anger, converting passion into righteous action.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: An example of emotional de-escalation, impulse control, and sublimating anger into constructive behavior.
